description: Lists the signed-in customer's orders with us, open and paid, each with its status. Needs the customer to be signed in; if they are not, your client will ask them to. Applies when the customer asks what they have with us, wants to pick up a saved order, or asks where an order is.

include.description: Which orders to list: everything (the default), only open unpaid ones, or only paid ones.

name: my_orders

orders.description: Every order on this account, open and paid, latest activity first.

delivers_by.description: For a paid order, the date it is planned to arrive by.

expired.description: An expired order is kept; call resume_order to pick it up.

label.description: The status in words a customer can read. A paid order reads "Paid, in production" until it ships.

order_id.description: For an open order, use with describe_order, get_options, choose_option or create_checkout to continue.

status_url.description: For a paid order. Show it to the customer as one link labeled "Track your order", not as a bare address.

title: My orders
